def choose_move(observation):
    width = observation['grid_width']
    height = observation['grid_height']
    my_pos = observation['self_position']
    opp_pos = observation['opponent_position']
    resources = observation['resources']
    obstacles = observation['obstacles']
    score_self = observation['scores'][0]
    score_opp = observation['scores'][1]
    
    def is_free(x, y):
        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= width or y >= height:
            return False
        if [x, y] in obstacles:
            return False
        return True
    
    dx = dy = 0
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-my_pos[0]) + abs(r[1]-my_pos[1]))
        delta_x = target[0] - my_pos[0]
        delta_y = target[1] - my_pos[1]
        if abs(delta_x) > abs(delta_y):
            dx = 1 if delta_x > 0 else -1
        elif delta_y != 0:
            dy = 1 if delta_y > 0 else -1
    else:
        # No resources, move towards opponent or stay put
        delta_x = opp_pos[0] - my_pos[0]
        delta_y = opp_pos[1] - my_pos[1]
        if abs(delta_x) > abs(delta_y):
            dx = 1 if delta_x > 0 else -1
        elif delta_y != 0:
            dy = 1 if delta_y > 0 else -1

    # Check if move is valid, else stay
    new_x = my_pos[0] + dx
    new_y = my_pos[1] + dy
    if not is_free(new_x, new_y):
        dx = dy = 0

    return [dx, dy]
